mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and higher corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS > 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening supply-side activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances during easing cycles.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 3-month average signals strengthening labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 3-month average.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST > 12-month MA and UNRATE < 6%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 > 2% YoY.
